description: What a Robinhood Chain token did in the hour before a Telegram call on it was posted, for every call our desk saw in the last 48 h: buy swaps and ETH in the 10 minutes before the post, the run over the hour before (run60), the token's age at the call, the most buy txs in one block, and the pre-post buyers' wallets (on-chain addresses; distinct wallets and the most in one block). flags = the bot's own veto rules that match: run (>= 3x in the hour before), young (< 30 min old at the call), cluster (>= 5 wallets in one block). No chat names, callers or message text. Tokens with no call answer 404 and are not charged. Data rewritten every 30 s; refused (503, not charged) if older than 180 s. Research data from our own paper-trading desk, not trading advice. Costs $0.02 USDC per call (x402).

addr.description: Robinhood Chain token contract address (0x + 40 hex)
